title: Orange Built a $1 Base vs Blue's $1,000,000 Fortress! (Full Movie)
description:
An extinction-level asteroid is 24 hours from impact. Genius billionaire Blue Stickman spends $1,000,000 on an AI-powered Titanium Fortress with plasma turrets and an electromagnetic shield. Orange Stickman turns his hoodie pockets inside out... and only has $1 and pure street physics.

When supersonic meteors, armored magma titans, and a 10,000-ton EMP core strike at midnight, only one base survives — leading to an impossible 12-second choice.
